details: VELDO-0077 detail: install/assets: .veldo/control_objective.py installed by the scaffold; .veldo/control_objective.py engine copy identical; .veldo/control_objective.py laid by the installer

VELDO-0077 detail: acceptance/intake-source: no other command writes an objective or a feature id; the objective is created PROPOSED from that proposal, in its one project; an inbox proposal with no project is refused; a proposal for a project that is not active is refused; a second objective from the same proposal is refused; a record that is not an intake proposal is refused; an acceptor other than the project owner is refused
VELDO-0077 detail: acceptance/stale-answer: the amendment is a new revision with a new bound digest; the stale answer is refused by name; the objective is unchanged and still PROPOSED
VELDO-0077 detail: acceptance/owner-only: it does not accept the objective; the objective is still PROPOSED at revision 2

VELDO-0077 detail: acceptance/binds-fields: the owner's answer settled and accepted the objective; the accepted revision is the one presented; outcome, scope, authority and evidence requirements are bound exactly; the owner was shown each bound field; the acceptance names the settlement and the owner

VELDO-0077 detail: acceptance/later-feature: the feature is proposed under the accepted objective and the objective is ACTIVE; the feature is RAW: neither admitted nor prioritized by the acceptance; admission is its own settled decision on the feature; the feature record stays RAW after that separate decision

VELDO-0077 detail: acceptance/bounded-elaboration: a feature outside the accepted scope is refused by name; no feature record was written for it; a feature under an objective that is not accepted is refused
VELDO-0077 detail: satisfaction/wrong-signer: a person who is not the bound assessor is refused; a service is refused; the objective is unchanged

VELDO-0077 detail: satisfaction/missing-evidence: an assessment without a required item is refused; an item naming no kept record is refused; an item naming another digest is refused; the objective is still ACTIVE
VELDO-0077 detail: satisfaction/stale-revision: an assessment of revision 1, not the accepted revision 2, is refused; the objective is still ACTIVE

VELDO-0077 detail: satisfaction/unproven-outcome: the objective is accepted and every one of its specifications is shipped; the assessment is refused as an unproven outcome; the objective is not satisfied

VELDO-0077 detail: satisfaction/proven: the bound assessor's complete, current assessment satisfies the objective; the receipt is the objective_satisfied fact of the accepted revision; each evidence item is the kept record by its digest; a second assessment of a satisfied objective is refused

VELDO-0077 detail: satisfaction/other-process: the other process read the store read-only; it sees the satisfied objective and its accepted revision; it sees the shipped-but-unproven objective still ACTIVE; the assessor's signature verifies independently

VELDO-0077 detail: cancel/work-disposition: a cancel with no disposition of the unfinished features is refused; a cancel disposing of only one of them is refused; a disposition recorded by someone else is refused; another project_owner member cannot cancel; nothing changed while refused; the owner's explicit dispositions cancel the objective; the stopped feature is CANCELED with its disposition recorded; the transferred feature now belongs to the other accepted objective
VELDO-0077 detail: cancel/history-kept: the earlier history entries are kept unchanged; the owner, acceptance and accepted revision are kept; the features list is kept

VELDO-0077 detail: cancel/reopen-linked: reopening the canceled objective is refused by the lifecycle; amending it is refused; a continuation must name a terminal objective; a new objective linked to it continues the work; the canceled objective is byte-for-byte unchanged
VELDO-0077 detail: observability: accepted and refused commands are counted; the pending work is exposed
